guitar.notes: Mark Morton and Willie Adler are known for ESP and ESP signature models in modern metal rigs.

tone.target: tight modern metal rhythm with scooped mids
tone.profile: tight modern metal rhythm with scooped mids
tone.summary: A modern metal chain utilizing a powerful distortion (RAT-style) for aggressive crunch, followed by the Recti amp model into a 4x12 cabinet to achieve massive low-end punch and tightness.
corrections: replace fuzz with tight high-gain distortion

rig.name: Lamb Of God - Redneck - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise inherent in high-gain metal playing.
Provide a clean, aggressive boost for palm-muted rhythm parts.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate an overdrive pedal's role without adding unwanted coloration, focusing on pure gain lift.

blocks.purpose: Provide tight, aggressive distortion necessary for modern metal chugging.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style model is chosen over Muff/Chief for its tighter, more focused aggression suitable for rhythmic palm muting.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the massive, scooped-mid character of a 5150/Recto style amp.
Provide a solid, punchy foundation for the low-end frequencies.
blocks.gap: While specific 5150 cabs are ideal, the UK Vintage 4x12 provides the necessary size and punch to complement the Recti model.

blocks.purpose: Scoop the mids and boost low-end punch for a modern metal sound.
blocks.gap: The EQ is crucial for achieving the 'scooped mid' tone required by the genre.

blocks.purpose: Kept inactive to maintain a dry, percussive attack.
blocks.gap: The WAH module is bypassed entirely as requested by the 'dry' and 'percussive' requirements.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal, controlled room ambience without washing out the tight rhythm.
blocks.gap: The reverb is kept very low to maintain dryness while adding slight depth.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better match the 5150/Recto tone and enhance low-end punch.

proposals.reason: Better captures the specific character of a 5150/Recto cab.
